.dag-toolbar__board > svg: the kind mark beside the toolbar's board name; an aria-hidden icon
.dag-modelpicker__searchIcon: the magnifier inside the model picker's field; an icon
.dag-sidebar__chev: the open/shut chevron on a folder row; an aria-hidden state indicator
.dag-vault__item:disabled: a disabled control: a vault whose folder is missing cannot be opened
.dag-sidebar__menu-where > svg: the folder mark in the New menu's destination row; an icon
.dag-pagemore__menu .dag-more__item:disa: a disabled control: a page action this board does not offer
.dag-hit__where svg: the kind mark beside a search hit; an aria-hidden icon
.dag-inspector__name::before: the separator dot before the picked item's name
.dag-settings__toast-dot: the decorative dot in the Settings save toast; not text
.dag-prompt__text:disabled: a disabled control: a prompt card that cannot be edited
.dag-board__kind: the kind mark before a board's name in the search list; an aria-hidden icon
.dag-task-glyph[data-status=\"todo\"]: the status mark for a to-do task; an aria-hidden icon
.dag-facts__label > svg: the mark beside a fact's label; an aria-hidden icon
.dag-projectbar__swatch > svg: the chevron on the project colour button; an aria-hidden state indicator
.dag-tasks__twisty > svg:first-child: the twisty on a task group; a state indicator
.dag-toolbar__practice:disabled: a disabled control: practice is unavailable while the quiz is empty
.dag-quizzes__practice:disabled: a disabled control: practice is unavailable while there is nothing to practise
.dag-quiz__grip: the drag grip on a quiz question or answer; an icon
.dag-run__button:disabled: a disabled control: the answer cannot be checked yet
.dag-calendar__show-toggle .dag-calendar: the chevron on the calendar's Show button; a state indicator
.dag-tablepage__problem-fix:disabled: a disabled control: the fix has nothing to act on
.dag-grid__head-in > svg: the mark inside a table column header; an icon
.dag-grid__menu-item:disabled: a disabled control: the column action is unavailable here
.dag-trash__mark: the kind mark on a trash row; an icon
.dag-trash-notice__mark: the mark on the trash notice; an icon
.dag-vault__item:disabled .dag-vault__ti: a disabled control: the name and path of a vault whose folder is missing
.dag-hits__new > svg: the mark beside Search's make-a-file row; an aria-hidden icon
